summary: Server one-frame event that a spell zone finished. esv::zone::DestructionSystem::ProcessFinishedSurfaceActions (EoCServer.dll+0x114CA70) creates a new entity per finished zone, adds this component (FUN_18114a310) with +0 = the zone entity and +8 = esv::zone::SpellComponent +0 of that zone, then destroys the zone entity. Seen alive when a Mud Mephit cast a spell, together with zone::CreateRequest/SpellComponent.
